evidence: Modifies kernel error definitions and the C/C++ notification interface in src/kernel/error.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and src/kernel/notifications_interface.h to remove UI translation from libbitcoinkernel.
rationale: Replaces string-based error notifications across the kernel boundary with typed error structures to remove util/translation.h from libbitcoinkernel. This directly advances the project's core goal of decoupling node dependencies from the kernel library under tracking issue #27587.
